stories.title: “She put people first”: Tributes to Mold councillor Teresa Carberry, who has died aged 64
stories.summary: Cllr Teresa Carberry’s family have led tributes to the popular Flintshire county councillor after she passed away on Wednesday. Aged 64 Teresa, the elected member for Mold Broncoed Ward, had been ill for some time – although she still found strength to chair council committees until very recently. She passed away at Nightingale House Hospice.

stories.title: Safety first as councillor tells Flintshire residents with on-street parking not to buy electric cars
stories.summary: Flintshire’s Cabinet Member for the Environment has advised residents not to purchase electric cars if they can’t charge them.
